rules.description: Block Read/Edit/Write on secret files — the one line nobody should relax
Only truly catastrophic shell commands wait for a human
rules.condition: tool_name == "Bash" && has(params.command) && (params.command.contains("rm -rf /") || params.command.contains("rm -rf ~") || params.command.contains("rm -rf C:") || params.command.contains("dd if=") || params.command.contains("mkfs") || params.command.contains("DROP DATABASE") || params.command.contains(":(){"))
